key_decisions.rationale: Retains shadow/form and repeated sacrificial inability.
key_decisions.before: For since the law has only a shadow of the good things to come, and not the true form of these realities, it can never—by the same sacrifices that are offered continually year after year—make people who approach complete.
key_decisions.after: Since the law has only a shadow of the good things to come, not their true form, it can never perfect those who approach through the same sacrifices continually offered year after year.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For since the law has only a shadow of the good things to come, and not the true form of these realities, it can never—by the same sacrifices that are offered continually year after year—make those who draw near complete.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps animal blood and explicit impossibility.

key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains incarnation setting and the Greek body's prepared reading.
